tagline: Premium teaching reels: captions that mix an elegant script with bold words at chest height, glowing glass cards and numbered diamonds in your studio colour, and your face gliding into a floating card.
readiness_note: Best with a coloured-light set; screenshots or exports of what you teach make the tutorial cards real (otherwise they are built as examples).

captions: F-A hook: duet caption builds at chest while a row of glowing cards slides in
F-A step: a glass diamond marker, then the full-screen tutorial card with sparkle bullets
F-B course sales: chrome title, numbered glass tiles, DM-or-comment keyword chip
